info.name: Drop Black BFF API
info.description:
Drop Black BFF requests (desk service), matching avn-api-tests' Maverick BFF collection.

Setup: in the collection Variables tab, fill in the Current value of email and password
(leave Initial value blank so your password is never shared or exported).
Then send auth > Login. The JWT lasts 10 minutes, so send Login again when requests return 401/403.

Send desks > List desks once to fill deskUid, locationUid and routeUid.
Create requests save the new uid, so Edit and Delete act on the item you just created.
Known bugs requests clean up after themselves. Their Test Results fail until the bug is fixed.

request.description: Logs in and saves the JWT into {{JWT}}. Lasts 10 minutes.

item.name: Weather data
item.description: Weather data: airgram, maritime meteogram, model compare, model verify and nearest stations (CSV rows 29-33). All read-only.

request.description: CSV row 29. Read-only. model mpas (default), gfs or ecmwf; hoursBack 0-24; hoursForward 1-120.
CSV row 30. Read-only. Inland points return the timeline with null marine values.
CSV row 31. Read-only. Leave models empty to compare all; interval is a Go duration (1h, 30m, 3h; no days).
CSV row 32. Read-only. parameter: temperature, temperatureDewPoint, windSpeed, windGust, windDirection, relativeHumidity, pressureAltimeter, visibility, ceiling or qpf. historyHours 2-48.
CSV row 33. limit 1-25, default 3.

request.description: CSV row 34. Read-only. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, at most 60 days apart; the dates are set to tomorrow automatically.
